coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 2 figures

top_level.current_content: Orquestación y VP RPA + AI Analyst
top_level.justification: Matches roadmap ownership and section role.

top_level.current_content: VP RPA + AI Analyst: Excel/sistema → validación → análisis → modelo/IA → informe → aprobación → borrador de correo. Demo con datos sintéticos, evidencia de cada estado y recuperación de fallas.
top_level.improved_content: VP RPA + AI Analyst: integra artefactos versionados desde fuente/validación hasta IA y reporte; exige gates humanos positivos, crea y luego aprueba el draft exacto, conserva lineage por estado y demuestra reanudación con fallos inyectados antes de promover N2.
top_level.justification: Current tagline claims state evidence/recovery and an approval order that theory does not earn.

top_level.current_content: Aquí orquestas una cadena completa de principio a fin: Excel o sistema → validación → análisis → IA asistida → informe → aprobación humana → borrador de correo. En un escritorio de operaciones en Lima demuestras evidencia por estado, recuperación ante fallas y costo acotado. Sin autofraude ni envío sin aprobación registrada en el audit trail.
top_level.improved_content: Aquí orquestas una cadena completa con artefactos sintéticos y provenance verificable: fuente → validación → análisis → propuesta de IA validada → informe → revisión humana → draft → aprobación final del draft exacto. Demuestras recuperación mediante restart/failure fixtures y calculas costo/valor desde observaciones del run. No se emiten etiquetas automáticas de fraude ni se considera una aprobación válida sin actor autorizado, timestamp y binding al artefacto exacto.
top_level.justification: Professional relevance must describe controls that actually exist in the evidence package.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Validar un DAG acíclico y modelar estados/transiciones observables por task y flow, incluidos failed/skipped, timestamp y run_id.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current code only topologically orders the happy-path chain.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir un run manifest inmutable/versionado, validar y aplicar límites de rate/concurrencia, y demostrar enable/disable de un schedule con timezone explícita.
learning_outcomes.justification: Declaring values in a dict/string is not configuring/enforcing them.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Persistir checkpoints fuera del proceso, clasificar fallos, ejecutar retries bounded con backoff+jitter y operar DLQ con lineage, owner, SLA y redrive.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current implementation lacks persistence, classification, actual delay/jitter and operational DLQ state.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar idempotencia persistente con payload validation, exclusión concurrente/lease y compensaciones que preserven la historia del artefacto.
learning_outcomes.justification: 'Garantizar' is untenable while writes overwrite and no lock exists.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Diseñar tres gates humanos que exijan estado approved del artifact/version exacto y reciban propuestas de IA previamente validadas y trazables.
learning_outcomes.justification: pending==0 is not approval and S25 outputs cannot be trusted by label.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Operar aprobación, rechazo, edición y auditoría
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Registrar decisiones autorizadas con timestamp y binding al artifact/version; exigir reasons; versionar edits y persistir audit append-only.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current list-based act() omits every material enforcement property.

learning_outcomes.improved_content: Definir SLI, población, ventana y SLO coherentes, derivar alerts y ejecutar un runbook que separa paging, quiesce, drain/cancel y recovery.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current daily/7d mismatch and page-after-drain sequence are not a stable operational contract.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Validar E2E, seguridad, costo y métricas de valor
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Derivar E2E/security/cost/value/regression from executed runs and manifests, including negative failure/reject scenarios and complete lineage; never hardcode promotion evidence.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current final package self-certifies every KPI/control.

theory_code_outputs.title: dag_states.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Kahn-like topo returns a list of names for the canonical chain; it does not detect leftover cyclic nodes or emit any state/timestamp/run_id.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: After traversal require len(order)==len(nodes) else raise CycleError; use deterministic tie-break; model node records/transitions and use separate pre-draft and final-draft approval nodes.
theory_code_outputs.justification: The helper currently demonstrates ordering only, not a valid/stateful DAG contract.

theory_code_outputs.title: limits_meta.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Returns mutable metadata with manual trigger/schedule None and prints a cron string; accepts any api_rpm.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: validate_limits() must reject >policy; manifest includes git/config/source hashes and is frozen/hashed; limiter/semaphore enforces values; scheduler adapter records timezone and enabled state.
theory_code_outputs.justification: Metadata and cron strings are not enforcement.

theory_code_outputs.title: ckpt_dlq.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Computes backoff numbers separately, retries flaky_ids immediately, creates an in-memory checkpoint and DLQ with id/reason/owner.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Use persistent checkpoint store; typed failure classifier; actual capped backoff+jitter; transient-then-success fixture; DLQ record with run/item hash, attempts, timestamps, owner, SLA and redrive status.
theory_code_outputs.justification: The output does not prove restart or actual backoff.

theory_code_outputs.title: rollback.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: write_report/write_draft overwrite by run_id; no concurrency lock; rollback pops draft and replaces report body with status only.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Atomic idempotency record with full key+payload hash+INPROGRESS/COMPLETE; lease for concurrent writer; compensation appends status/version while retaining report/draft audit snapshot.
theory_code_outputs.justification: Current result is evidence destruction, not create-once plus compensation.

theory_code_outputs.title: review_queues.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Counts only status='pending' and declares all_clear when all counts are zero; fixture has recipient pending despite paragraph saying zero.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Require each expected artifact/version to have approved decision bound to reviewer/timestamp/hash; rejected/error/missing blocks. Use the same fixture as prose.
theory_code_outputs.justification: Absence of pending is not positive approval.

theory_code_outputs.title: audit_hitl.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Appends arbitrary action/actor/reason to a mutable list; no ts, reason enforcement, edit version, authorization or artifact binding.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Validate action/actor role; reject requires reason; edit creates immutable artifact v+1; decision includes run/artifact/version/hash/timestamp; persist append-only events.
theory_code_outputs.justification: The current output can be produced by an unauthorized, reasonless, ambiguous decision.

theory_code_outputs.title: slo_alerts.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Compares precomputed 7d values to thresholds and prints runbook text; prose calls success target daily.
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Derive SLI from eligible run events with one declared 7d window/error budget; page by severity; quiesce new work and drain/cancel with timeout/policy rather than delaying page until after drain.
theory_code_outputs.justification: Alert arithmetic is not an SLO/runbook implementation without event semantics.

theory_code_outputs.title: e2e_value.py
theory_code_outputs.current_behavior: Assigns success to every step and literal audit/cost/value/fraud/regression values without executing anything.
theory_code_outputs.current_output: draft_email success; audit 3; cost_tokens 1200; fraud_labels 0; n2_regression pass; value_min 45
theory_code_outputs.improved_content: Execute the real synthetic adapters/stubs; derive states/artifact hashes/security checks/cost/value; import regression manifests; inject transient/permanent/reject failures; calculate promotion from evidence only.
theory_code_outputs.justification: This is a manufactured green package, not E2E evidence.

callouts.title: Criterio de promoción N2
callouts.current_content: La promoción exige CP-N2-A/B/C, regresión S14–S26 y CF-2 aprobados con evidencia reproducible.
callouts.justification: Correct gate; T4-B must stop self-certifying it.

callouts.title: Estados visibles
callouts.current_content: El dashboard del VP muestra el estado de cada nodo con timestamp y run_id.
callouts.improved_content: El dashboard solo muestra un estado derivado de eventos reales por nodo: state, run_id, started_at/finished_at y artifact_ref; un nodo skipped nunca cuenta como success.
callouts.justification: Current code supplies none of these fields.

callouts.title: Metadata inmutable
callouts.current_content: No reescribas metadata tras el start; versiona un nuevo run_id.
callouts.improved_content: Persiste/hashea un run manifest con source/config/git/schema versions; cualquier cambio crea un nuevo run_id. Un dict mutable por convención no demuestra inmutabilidad.

callouts.title: DLQ no es basurero
callouts.current_content: Cada mensaje en DLQ tiene owner y SLA de inspección; no se borra el rastro.
callouts.improved_content: Cada registro DLQ conserva lineage, attempts/failures, owner, SLA, timestamps, retention y estado de redrive/reject; una alerta detecta backlog o SLA vencido.
callouts.justification: Current DLQ omits SLA and operating state.

callouts.title: Compensación
callouts.current_content: Rollback no siempre es transacción ACID; define compensaciones explícitas (draft fuera, report superseded).
callouts.improved_content: La compensación puede retirar/cancelar el efecto activo, pero el audit store conserva snapshots/hashes y registra `canceled`/`superseded`; cleanup no borra historia.
callouts.justification: Current pop/replace destroys the defense history.

callouts.title: Triple gate
callouts.current_content: Sin las tres revisiones en verde, no hay draft_email.
callouts.improved_content: El draft solo se crea cuando analysis/report/recipient tienen decisiones `approved` para las versiones exactas; después el draft exacto y recipients requieren aprobación final separada antes de cualquier envío futuro.

callouts.title: Razones obligatorias en reject
callouts.current_content: Reject sin reason se rechaza a nivel API.
callouts.improved_content: La función/API valida `reject`: reason_code permitido y comentario cuando corresponda; un reject vacío produce ValidationError y no agrega un audit event válido.

callouts.title: P0 unapproved send
callouts.current_content: Cualquier envío sin approve es incidente P0 aunque sea sandbox mal configurado.
callouts.improved_content: Cualquier envío sin **aprobación final autorizada del draft exacto y recipient set exacto** es P0; una preaprobación del report/recipient no sustituye ese control.

callouts.title: CF-2 y regresión
callouts.current_content: CF-2 fija interfaces entre Familiarity, reporting y automatización. La regresión N2 no se «compensa» entre capstones.
callouts.improved_content: CF-2 y cada suite requerida aportan manifests de resultado ligados al mismo commit/contratos compatibles; falta o fallo en uno bloquea promoción y no puede sustituirse con un literal pass de otra suite.
callouts.justification: Turns non-compensation into an evidence rule.

figures.current_caption: Confundir skipped con success infla la tasa de éxito con tareas que nunca corrieron.
figures.current_alt: Cinco guardas que asignan a cada tarea su estado, de pending a skipped.
figures.improved_content: Diagrama de un nodo `pending→running→success|failed`; un dependiente de failed pasa a skipped, y la métrica success_rate excluye skipped. Añadir run_id/timestamps junto a cada transición.
figures.justification: The visual references skipped guards that theory code never implements; make it directly support state/SLI semantics.

figures.current_caption: El checkpoint solo cumple su promesa si sobrevive al proceso; un set en memoria muere con él.
figures.current_alt: Cuatro etapas —ingest, analyze, checkpoint, report— con la frontera dibujada tras el checkpoint.
figures.justification: Accurately exposes the persistence boundary; implementation must catch up rather than changing this figure.
